verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Nix offering a compatibility layer, command aliases, or interface conventions that mirror an incumbent tool such as apt or Homebrew. Its commands (nix-env, nix-shell, nix develop, flakes) are Nix-specific, and one community comment warns switchers 'You won't like the CLI though.' Nix running alongside the existing package manager is coexistence, not familiar commands, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can keep using familiar commands and interface conventions from the incumbent tool while adopting this manager
